items.title: Trump could get frosty G7 reception amid confusion over Iran ceasefire
items.description: Conflicting information is being released about the US-Iran ceasefire agreement announced at the weekend, including whether Iran will introduce tolls on the Strait of Hormuz in the future.

items.title: Labor's CGT plan flawed but better than what we have, economists tell inquiry
items.description: Economists have offered qualified support for the government's plans on day one of a Senate inquiry.

items.title: 'Devastated' family reveal scale of young mother's shark attack injuries
items.description: Leah Stewart was swimming at Coogee Beach when she was attacked just before 11am on Saturday.

items.title: Live: Spain aim to dodge banana skin against Cabo Verde
items.description: Spain and Cabo Verde meet in Atlanta, as one of the big favourites looks to avoid an embarrassing slip up. Follow live.

items.title: 'I screamed': A mother's grief as drug overdose deaths hit record high
items.description: Australia recorded its deadliest year on record for drug overdoses, according to a new analysis, with an average of seven deaths per day.

items.title: Private schoolboy plotted attack on LNP, court hears
items.description: Prosecutor says a private schoolboy who allegedly planned to bomb a public event was inspired by the "Unabomber".

items.title: Two men convicted of plot to torch property linked to British PM Keir Starmer
items.description: A Russian-speaking figure who went by the name "El Money" offered one of the men money to torch the properties and take video that could be posted online to draw attention to the attack.

items.title: PM to make fuel excise call early next week
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese says the government will give Australians "appropriate notice" about the fuel excise rebate, as it continues to monitor the issue.

items.title: White House UFC event ends with massive upset win in title fight
items.description: US President Donald Trump watches ring-side as the UFC event dubbed Freedom 250 ends with Justin Gaethje scoring a massive upset win over Ilia Topuria at the White House.

items.title: Ukrainian heritage-listed monastery severely damaged by Russian strike
items.description: Four people have been killed after a Russian strike hit a 900-year-old monastery in central Kyiv.

items.title: AFP begins inquiry into allegations Israeli forces assaulted flotilla activists
items.description: Australian Federal Police have begun inquiries into allegations that Israeli defence personnel sexually assaulted Australian activists on a flotilla headed to Gaza, following a meeting with Foreign Minister Penny Wong.

items.title: Shackleton's hut could pose explosive risk to Antarctic explorers
items.description: Chemicals found inside two of Antarctica's most important historical sites, Ernest Shackleton and Robert Falcon Scott's huts, could pose "potential explosive hazards", a report has warned.

items.title: 'Sharp increase' in drone strikes leads to 1,000 civilian deaths in Sudan
items.description: The United Nations has condemned an increase in drone attacks in conflict-torn Sudan.

items.title: Cairns man charged after allegedly naming man at centre of extortion case
items.description: A Cairns man accused of exposing the identity of a Queensland public figure at the centre of a mysterious extortion case has been charged by police with allegedly disobeying a suppression order.

items.title: Simple 'fakeaway' recipes for when you're on a budget
items.description: Ordering in of an evening can become a costly exercise but these five tasty recipes are sure to hit the spot.

items.title: Woman denied bail over alleged plot to smuggle fugitive bikie out of WA
items.description: Queensland woman Jessica Beckett told a West Australian court she did not know an outlaw bikie gang member was on the boat she was sailing to Indonesia.

items.title: Stepson of Norway's crown prince convicted of rape
items.description: Marius Borg Høiby, 29, has been found guilty of two counts of rape and other crimes.

items.title: Clothing stunt turns into 'riot' as crowd clashes with police
items.description: Newcastle residents and authorities condemn a clothing company stunt that degenerated into a "riot" involving dozens of dirt bike riders.

items.title: UK plans to ban social media for under-16s
items.description: Sir Keir Starmer says he will ban social media sites for under-16s and impose restrictions on gaming and live streaming platforms in some of the most far-reaching online restrictions globally.

items.title: A lost Sam Pang went looking for something. He found comedy
items.description: This workplace satire starring Sam Pang has Tasmania's first ever AFL team firmly in its sights.

items.title: History quiz: Test yourself on these past events
items.description: When was Salt Lake City awarded the XIX Winter Olympics? And how much do you know about the Fast and the Furious films? Test yourself in this week's history quiz.

items.title: Crown alleges man accessed $5.7m dark web bitcoin to buy home
items.description: Prosecutors allege the house Jamie Lawrence Powrie was arrested at was bought with the cryptocurrency acquired through illegal dark web activity.

items.title: Dog rescued after being trapped for five days in breakwater
items.description: A 14-year-old fox terrier is back in her owner's arms after a multi-day stint trapped in the Glenelg breakwater after she broke free from her leash.

items.title: Legal bill and election breach added to minister's woes
items.description: Tasmania's racing minister is facing mounting calls to resign from cabinet, after evidence in parliament called into question what her office knew about messaging that breached election guidelines.

items.title: Police uncover note, unused life jackets at scene of 'senseless' murder-suicide
items.description: Investigators are trying to determine what led to a suspected murder-suicide on Saturday, after the bodies of a father and young child were recovered from a bay off Concord.
